title: Patient Payment Plans Fee Schedule Note: Amount of the Add-On Fee
content:
The add-on fee of the Patient Payment Plans is charged, on a tier whose setup fee is above 0.00, for every add-on booked on the plan, as one enrollment entry of the reason setup fee on the day the add-on is enrolled.

**Amount.** The add-on fee is scheduled at the tier's setup fee, the one-time setup fee shown for that tier in the fee and installment schedule of the Patient Payment Plans. The fee entered on the plan balance is the scheduled add-on fee rounded half up to the cent.

| Quantity | How it is set |
|---|---|
| Scheduled add-on fee | The tier's setup fee |
| Add-on fee entered | The scheduled add-on fee, rounded half up to the cent |
| Date of the entry | The day the add-on is enrolled |

**Worked figure (hypothetical tier fee).** For a tier whose setup fee were 32.50, the scheduled add-on fee is 32.50 and the fee entered on the day of the add-on is 32.50.

**Points of judgement.**

- *What is the base of the fee?* The tier's own setup fee, read from the fee and installment schedule for the plan's tier.
- *Is a tier whose setup fee is 0.00 charged an add-on fee?* No; the fee is charged on tiers whose setup fee is above 0.00.
- *Rounding.* An amount exactly halfway between two cents goes to the higher cent.
